scientific_integrity: The proof is analytical; the exact-rational checker independently corroborates the explicit example and uniform-hub consistency checks. No independent audit or external certification was performed.
scientific_limitations: Local disease-free invasion only; no statement about final epidemic size or endemic equilibria.
Requires symmetric nonnegative row-stochastic travel, equal patch populations, common recovery, and one heterogeneous infection rate.
General linear-algebraic rank-one tests are pre-existing tools; published priority for the exact model-specific characterization remains a risk.
title: An exact spectral heterogeneity budget for one-hotspot metapopulation epidemics
